Excellent food, pork with lemongrass and chicken with broccoli very tasty.
Mar 2020 • Couples
This place is truly a gem! Easy enough to find on Google Maps. Excellent food especially given the price. The pork with lemongrass was amazingly but lightly punchy, slightly peppery but not too much, and just very, very tasty. The broccoli and chicken was garlicky and just slightly al-dente, just as we like it. Both served with sticky steamed rice. We’re only here one night but would be back otherwise. The addition of very good priced drinks makes it a must. Highly recommend.
